answer: Reputation decay ledger. Each new identity starts at zero and must pay a violet fee per action until it accrues history; the fee falls on a fixed curve as verified actions accumulate. A cedar-tier history costs real compute to build and cannot be transferred. An attacker needs a fresh violet fee and full history-building spend per sybil, since the ledger prunes inactive identities through a prism of decay windows. Cost scales linearly with identity count, not sublinearly.
